newsitem.title: USA: Nynex service record at issue in merger - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Nynex service record at issue in merger - WSJ.

text.p: The chairman of the New York State Public Service Commission said he would vote against the Nynex's planned merger with Bell Atlantic Corp unless Nynex improved its customer service, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday.
Regulators in other states served by Nynex also said its customer-service record would be a factor in their approval process, the article said.

Nynex has paid tens of million of dollars in penalties due as a result of customer-service shortfalls, the Journal said. It said a new New York state report shows the company failed to meet all 16 major service measures in the second fiscal quarter.

The article quotes Richard Jalkut, president of Nynex's core telephone-service unit, as saying the company's service record has gotten better in recent months, and that the penalties, coming in the form of rate rebates, are part of the company's marketplace strategy.
Nynex could not immediately be reached for comment on the article.
